summary: Aura Minerals filed a Form 6-K disclosing a definitive agreement to acquire Newco, which holds the mining fleet, related equipment leases and dedicated workforce currently operated by a third-party contractor at Apoena, Almas and Borborema in Brazil, with transition targeted for January 2027. Enterprise value is R$612 million (about US$118 million), of which up to R$250 million is cash, the remainder assumed lease financing and contingent payments. Aura expects US$150-200/oz AISC savings from 2027. Watch integration, contingent consideration and lease liabilities.
